user_story: As a guest, I want booking creation to fail if any required field is missing so that incomplete bookings are not saved.

positive.title: Create booking with all required fields filled
steps: Enter all required fields such as name, date, and time
positive.expected_result: Booking is created successfully and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Booking creation fails if the name field is missing
steps: Fill in the booking date and time
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the name field is required.

negative.title: Booking creation fails if the date field is missing
steps: Fill in the name and time
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the date field is required.

negative.title: Booking creation fails if the time field is missing
steps: Fill in the name and date
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the time field is required.

edge.title: Booking creation fails with all required fields missing
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed for each required field indicating they are required.

edge.title: Booking creation fails with extraneous fields filled but required fields missing
steps: Fill in optional notes field, leave required fields like name, date, and time empty
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating all required fields are missing.
